newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Two Bosnian entities hold interbank talks.
newsitem.headline: Two Bosnian entities hold interbank talks.

text.p: The Bosnian Serb Republic and the Moslem-Croat federation central bank officials met in Doboj on Monday to discuss the establishment of inter-bank cooperation, Bosnian Serb news agency Srna said.
Accordong to Srna the meeting was held under the auspices of the International Monetary Fund for Bosnia.
The meeting is a follow-up of talks held earlier in Tuzla.

Development and reconstruction of the banking system in the two entities, a Bosnian Serb republic and a Moslem-Croat federation, and investments of foreign financial institutions in Bosnian reconstruction is on the agenda, SRNA said.
The Bosnian Serbs are represented by deputy central bank governor Petra Markovic and the federation by central bank vice-governor Obrad Piljak.
